definition: OMIM #621304 designates Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy 119 (DEE119), a severe neurodevelopmental disorder and spliceosomopathy caused by pathogenic variants in the non-coding small nuclear RNA gene RNU2-2. It is characterized by global developmental delay, severe-to-profound intellectual disability, refractory seizures, and hyperkinetic movement disorders.

source.title: Prominent Movement Disorders in RNU2‐2‐Related Spliceosomopathy
